# betterado_pipeline (Data Source)

Reads a Pipelines v2 pipeline (`_apis/pipelines`) from Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_pipeline" "example" {
  project_id  = data.betterado_project.example.id
  pipeline_id = 42
}

output "pipeline_name" {
  value = data.betterado_pipeline.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_id` (Number) The integer ID of the pipeline.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the pipeline belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `configuration_type` (String) The configuration type of the pipeline.
- `folder` (String) The folder path of the pipeline.
- `id` (String) The pipeline integer ID as a string (set as the data source ID).
- `name` (String) The name of the pipeline.
- `revision` (Number) The pipeline revision number.
- `url` (String) The URL of the pipeline.
